remarks: Welcome to 27 Hyatt Avenue in Norwalk. Spacious and clean two bedroom end unit in a side-by-side duplex. Open concept living. Includes 2 large bedrooms, 1 full bathroom, living room and kitchen. Conveniently located minutes from Norwalk Hospital, I95 (Exit 14,15), Rt 7, SONO + CT Ave. You will quickly notice the landlord maintains the property with much pride both inside and out. Current tenants vacate end of November. Unit will be meticulously cleaned prior to lease start date. High efficiency on demand natural gas heat/hot water, central air newer windows keep the utilities LOW! (2) Assigned parking spaces + Washer/Dryer in unit for your comfort. Street parking for guests. Plenty of cabinet/closet space/attic for storage. No pets/No smoking allowed. Landlord requesting good credit, proof of income and references.
